answer: When a canyon relay repeats an identity's echo claim after a gale-delayed recheck, any mismatch freezes its rewards and slashes 4,500 POA from its bond per false claim, repeating for each additional fake tied to the same operator. The relay publishes the mismatched echo, and other relays refuse to forward that identity until the bond is topped up. An operator running eight fakes loses 36,000 POA before any reward clears.
